about: Huginn/Muninn 0.6 test vectors (docs/protocol-0.6.md), made by tools/proto06_ref.py. Static keys A and B are those of chat-vectors.json; C is the P-256 key with private value 0x33 repeated 32 times, TV 0x44 repeated 32 times. Call ephemeral keys: offerer (A) 0x3001, answerer (B) 0x4001. Signatures here are RFC 6979 (deterministic) so the file never changes; apps may sign with random k and must only verify. 'signed' is the exact UTF-8 text that is signed (domain line, newline, canonical JSON without sig). 'hash' is SHA-256 of the canonical JSON with sig. Packets and keys are hex. Every 'accept' and 'receive' step must give the same result, in the order listed (receive steps share one receiver per side).

accept.why: first state, signed by one of its own admins
signer is not an admin in the current state
only the owner can hand over ownership
signer is not an admin in the current state

conflict.rule: same version 3: the lower hash wins; the admin whose change lost re-applies it as v4
